g.text: How Mida and TrustLayer work together
TrustLayer decides what an agent may do. Mida decides what it may know, and records what it did.
Runs these checks itself, in order:
1 Ask TrustLayer: may I act? (no: stop)
2 Ask Mida: the owner's brief (revoked: stop)
3 Does the amount fit the level's limit?
Mida service on the owner's machine
Owner delegates the agent, with a spending level
Revoke here: the agent may no longer DO anything (step 1 stops it)
1 May I act for this owner?
the chain says the owner wrote it)
The agent runs both checks itself; nothing on chain forces them. Monad testnet, not audited.
A re-run finds its own receipt and does not pay twice.
